changes: Explicit six-source allowlist: CTC, KDREAMS, WINTICKET, KEIRIN.JP, CHARILOTO, ODDSPARK.
Deterministic NFKC and whitespace normalization for rider names.
Deterministic venue suffix normalization for 競輪場 / 競輪.
Class notation normalization such as S級1班 -> S1.
Style notation normalization such as 追込/追込み -> 追 and 逃げ -> 逃.
Single complete trusted final Day1 racecard remains formally usable as SINGLE_SOURCE_READY; multi-source agreement is audit hardening only.
Two or more complete trusted observations must agree on race_no/car_no/class/style/circumference or the candidate fails closed.
OddsPark hostname false-positive fixed: oddspark.com hostname itself is not treated as an odds namespace; page role/title/path/query/fragment are checked instead.
